   - `basic_ofstream` has `open(path, out)` and `close()`, and it owns a `basic_filebuf`.
   - `basic_filebuf`’s destructor calls `close()`, so explicit close + RAII is safe.
   - Evidence: [`basic_ofstream` API](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/ded7aa0dcf4965aec5a1d036524cbc0fb14ad5e1/libcxx/include/fstream#L101-L131), [`basic_ofstream` member + close`](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/ded7aa0dcf4965aec5a1d036524cbc0fb14ad5e1/libcxx/include/fstream#L1347-L1449), [`basic_filebuf` dtor calls close`](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/ded7aa0dcf4965aec5a1d036524cbc0fb14ad5e1/libcxx/include/fstream#L503-L505)

5. **Preserve the async queue**
   - Keep the queue separate from filesystem I/O; only the consumer thread touches files.
   - Push explicit flush/terminate control messages and drain before shutdown.
   - Evidence from a real async logger design: queue messages carry a `shared_ptr` to the logger and destruction waits until queued messages drain; flush is an explicit queued message. [`async queue design`](https://github.com/gabime/spdlog/blob/2e71fdf3c1e8d6299b8129e402ab705e6fb494ba/include/spdlog/async.h#L7-L12), [`queue message types`](https://github.com/gabime/spdlog/blob/2e71fdf3c1e8d6299b8129e402ab705e6fb494ba/include/spdlog/details/thread_pool.h#L18-L18), [`post_flush`](https://github.com/gabime/spdlog/blob/2e71fdf3c1e8d6299b8129e402ab705e6fb494ba/include/spdlog/details/thread_pool-inl.h#L59-L66)
